text: Launched a standalone edition of the SCOOT 2.0 SIG collection, preserving all 20 groups, 8 series and 10 event recording collections. The SCOOT original is unchanged.

Collected 51 primary source pages (49 retrieved, 2 unavailable). Added October SPSC speakers, AISV’s November course and 2027 conference, and SSW14. Corrected ISCSLP 2026 to 14–17 November. Past calendar entries are now separated automatically.

Updated the SLaTE website to its Google Sites home after the historical homepage could not be retrieved. Kept unavailable sources and dated descriptions visible rather than treating a failed check as no activity.
